description: CARE and FERA reduce qualifying California utility bills. Apply to your utility company rather than to a state cash-assistance office.
introduction: CARE and FERA reduce qualifying California utility bills. Apply to your utility company rather than to a state cash-assistance office.

sections.who: CARE uses household income or participation in listed assistance programs, including Medi-Cal, SNAP, WIC and SSI. FERA serves households above CARE’s income limit within its own band; availability depends on the electric utility.
sections.get: CPUC lists CARE electric discounts of 30–35% at larger utilities and 20% at smaller ones, plus a 20% gas discount. FERA gives an 18% electricity discount at PG&E, SCE and SDG&E.
sections.docs: Have the utility account, household size and income or qualifying-benefit information ready. Ask the utility what verification it requires.
sections.apply:
1. Use the utility links on CPUC’s CARE/FERA page. Compare your household with the June 2026–May 2027 guidance.

  2. Complete the utility application and respond to verification requests. Ask about FERA if income is above CARE limits.
sections.after: Check the bill for enrollment and the discount. Follow utility renewal notices. If behind on payments, ask separately about arrears or payment plans.
sections.sources:
Application and program details: CARE/FERA discounts, limits and utility applications.

Historical screenshots and background: USA Assistance. Screenshots may show an earlier application interface.

faqs: Is this a payment sent to me?
Can benefits participation establish CARE eligibility?
The CPUC page lists qualifying programs; the utility verifies enrollment.
Is FERA available from every utility?
CPUC lists PG&E, SCE and SDG&E.
Does a discount erase overdue bills?
Ask the utility separately about arrears assistance or payment arrangements.
